variant.briefing:
Hey there, 

So the People’s Alliance hired us to move a load of cargo from Levski to [Destination]. Honestly, I’m surprised that they export some of this stuff, but I guess they must sell something to be able to afford everything they import. 

For the run itself, you’ll need a ship that can hold [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to handle the containers. That should be it.  

[Contractor]
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
